events.body:
This is a rider-cancellation fee dispute: the trace settles NS-0 as cancelled_by = rider at 08:46:40, 6 min 40 s after acceptance at 08:40:00, with $6.61 on record [F4][F7][NS-0]. The only NS branch open is NS-4 (immediate booking, rider cancels), and its condition is met: 08:46:40 minus 08:40:00 = 400 s > 3 min (180 s), so the $6.61 fee stands [F4][NS-4].

I read the chat, the complaint and the driver statement. The chat contains two timestamped messages: the driver announcing arrival with the car description, and the rider saying "Sorry, plans changed, I will cancel" [F9][F10][F11]. Neither message, nor the complaint text, nor the driver's written statement contains any threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation [F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1]. I therefore record safety_concern = "none" with basis F9, F10, F12 — nothing in the record requires the human safety route under SAFE-1 or SAFE-2.

The rider's complaint rests on the idea that the fee is unfair because the driver had not arrived. The record shows the contrary on arrival: platform arrival was recorded at 08:41:25, the driver's closest approach was 39 m, cumulative time within 200 m before the cancellation was 5 min 15 s, and the car was stationary 4 min 40 s at 41 m from the pickup [F1][F2][F3][F5]. More importantly, NS-4 does not turn on tolerance of driver lateness: Ryde publishes no free-cancellation right for a late driver, so the rider's remedy for lateness would be a human appeal, not a fee waiver [F4][NS-4].

The driver-side conditions do not create a separate charge: the "I'm Here" tap at 08:42:15, 40 m from the pickup, with 4 min 25 s within 200 m afterwards, together with the driver's statement that he was parked for minutes, support the fee already charged but add no new charge item [F6][F12][NS-1]. No refund formula applies, because rider cancellation under NS-4 is the operative branch, not a route-deviation refund [F7][F8][NS-4].

Because the fee is upheld, nothing is refundable and no action is needed; the profile facts (2 no-show disputes upheld for the driver, 0 upheld for the rider) are only context and are not used to decide the fee itself, and no clause calls for an account flag here [F16][F17][RD-6][NS-2]. Evidence is sufficient: the timeline, GPS and fare records cover the acceptance, arrival and cancellation moments, and the chat is complete with every message timestamped, so no element of NS-4 depends on a missing record [F2][F4][F5][F11].

Nothing is refunded and no voucher is issued. No action is being taken on your account.

The rider's message confirms they cancelled, and the records show you arrived promptly and waited close to the pickup point. No extra charge is added for this trip. No action is being taken on your account, and no change is made to your profile standing.
